# Vendored MathLive assets

MathLive 0.111.4, obtained from the official npm registry tarball mathlive-0.111.4.tgz. The unmodified minified ESM module and fonts are included for offline formula editing. License: LICENSE.txt. KaTeX attribution is retained in KaTeX-LICENSE.txt. Package tarball shasum reported by npm: a0cd84f8df107c76471ed0bc95c7e5f62faca057. No handwriting model weights are included here.

Sources: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathlive/v/0.111.4 and https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX.
